brief:
Settlers installed multiple caravans today in the Khallet Souar area south of Burein village, near Nablus, the Shehab wire agency reported. The placement represents an expansion of settler infrastructure in the region.

The move occurs amid a broader surge in settlement activities in the area. Authorities have documented increasing construction and infrastructure development by settlers across the occupied West Bank in recent weeks.
